program.help:
Inverse model of spike positions relative to the probe shank.
For each spike group, reads the .spk.N waveform file and the probe electrode site geometry (from the probes: section of the session YAML), then fits an extracellular potential model per spike to estimate where each neuron was relative to the probe.
MODEL (monopole) V_i = A / sqrt((x_i - x_s)^2 + (y_i - y_s)^2 + z_s^2)
(x_i, y_i) electrode site positions (µm) from probe geometry (x_s, y_s) source position in the shank plane (µm) z_s perpendicular distance from shank face (µm) A unsigned amplitude ∝ source current × tissue resistivity
The observation vector is the per-channel peak-to-peak amplitude of each spike. The fit minimises sum-of-squared residuals in log-amplitude space, which stabilises the scale of A relative to position.
PREREQUISITES Run AFTER ndm_pca (needs .spk.N). Probe geometry must be configured via the probes: section of the session YAML.
OUTPUT FILES SESSION.loc.N binary float32, little-endian, NO HEADER 5 values per spike: x_um y_um z_um amplitude residual_rms noise spikes (clu ≤ 1) are localised but get residual=NaN
SESSION.loc.yaml YAML sidecar with per-group metadata, site positions, and summary statistics
OPTIONAL PARAMETERS
# method Inverse model to use (default = monopole). monopole Point source model (recommended for single-shank probes). com Amplitude-weighted centre-of-mass — fast but no z_um estimate.
# clusterFilter Which spikes to fully localise (default = good). all Every spike regardless of cluster assignment. good Clusters ≥ 2 (excludes noise/MUA). Noise spikes still localised but flagged with residual_rms = NaN. single As 'good' but restricted to clusters that pass basic isolation (currently an alias for 'good' — reserved for future use).
# maxDistUm Reject a fit and output NaN if the estimated source position is further than this from the nearest electrode site (µm, default = 200). High residual fits that converge far from the array are likely artefacts.
# nBootstrap Number of bootstrap replicates per spike for position uncertainty estimation (default = 0 = disabled). When > 0, an additional output SESSION.loc.std.N (same layout as SESSION.loc.N) is written with the per-spike standard deviation across bootstrap replicates. Values of 50-200 are typical.
# overwrite If 1, delete existing .loc.N files and re-localise. If 0 (default), skip groups whose .loc.N already exists.
# probeLibrary Override probe library search path. Default search order: $NEUROSUITE_PROBE_PATH, ~/.local/share/neurosuite/probes/, /usr/local/share/neurosuite/probes/, /usr/share/neurosuite/probes/, probes/ (session-local directory).
